title: USD Layer 1 decision rules, version 1
scope: Turns the intended 25-factor book into one USD decision at 05:00 London: a direction, one of five conviction bands, and an explicit trade / no-trade answer.
owner_decision: The research names one unit of say per family and seven families, but never names the families, a combination rule, a band set or a gate. This version names six voting families (the seventh group, the data-quality gate, does not vote), fixes an equal-weight family vote, carries the inherited band-2 and band-3 thresholds, and freezes the result before any accuracy evaluation. It is a design decision, not a finding.
cutoff: 05:00 Europe/London. A print released after the cutoff cannot vote in that morning.

signals.label: US 2Y yield, five-session change
signals.vote_rule: sign of the five-session change in bps: higher votes +1 USD, lower -1, unchanged 0

signals.label: US 10Y real yield, five-session change
signals.vote_rule: sign of the five-session change in bps: higher votes +1 USD, lower -1, unchanged 0

signals.label: US minus Germany 2Y spread, five-session change
signals.vote_rule: sign of the five-session change in bps: widening votes +1 USD, narrowing -1, unchanged 0; F3 and the shared front-end row are the same print and never vote twice

signals.label: VIX level and risk regime
signals.vote_rule: the nine-input book's frozen VIX regime vote: high and rising volatility votes -1 USD, low and falling +1

signals.label: VIX five-session change
signals.vote_rule: the nine-input book's frozen VIX momentum vote: a rising five-session change votes -1 USD, a falling change +1

signals.label: Safe-haven demand
signals.source: Cached gold H1 and H.10 USD/JPY; CHF confirmation only
signals.vote_rule: RG-5: gold and JPY both weaken by more than 0.25% votes +1 USD, both strengthen -1, otherwise 0; CHF never votes alone

signals.label: Broad dollar momentum
signals.source: FRED DTWEXBGS, a declared stand-in for ICE DXY
signals.vote_rule: the nine-input book's frozen broad-dollar vote: a five-session rise votes +1 USD, a fall -1

signals.label: USD session momentum
signals.source: EUR/USD and USD/JPY cached H1 tape, declared proxies for the DXY path
signals.vote_rule: the mean of the two mirror votes; the pair is one factor and votes once, not twice

signals.label: Overnight range position
signals.vote_rule: RG-3: range position at least 0.70 votes +1 USD, at most 0.30 -1, otherwise 0; a range below 10 pips is undefined

signals.label: Gold five-session change
signals.source: Cached XAU/USD H1, labelled as the Coinbase quote
signals.vote_rule: the nine-input book's frozen gold vote: a five-session fall votes +1 USD, a rise -1

signals.label: Equity versus USD
signals.source: Cached NAS100 H1, labelled where the rule names QQQ
signals.vote_rule: the nine-input book's frozen equity vote: a five-session fall votes +1 USD, a rise -1

signals.label: F8 Fed bias
signals.vote_rule: RG-2: a hawkish statement shift votes +1 USD, dovish -1, neutral 0; a statement released after the cutoff cannot vote that morning

non_voting_gate.label: Data-quality gate
non_voting_gate.rule: A morning needs at least six usable voting signals, at least four usable families, and an open RG-4 volatility gate before a direction may be issued. The gate never adds or subtracts a vote.

direction.family_vote: arithmetic mean of the usable signal votes in the family, capped to [-1, +1] by construction
direction.net_score: sum of the usable family votes
direction.agreement: absolute net score divided by the number of usable families
direction.participation: usable voting signals divided by twelve
direction.deadband: no call when agreement is below 0.20, which is the frozen RG-8 deadband

eligibility.volatility_gate: RG-4 must be defined and open
eligibility.note: Six is RG-8's frozen minimum, carried unchanged. Four families is the smallest count at which a family-balanced vote can still disagree with itself.

bands.label: Watch
bands.meaning: A direction exists, but the book is close to its deadband or mostly absent.

bands.label: Weak
bands.meaning: The inherited band-2 threshold: a weak directional read, not a trade.

bands.label: Provisional trade
bands.meaning: The inherited provisional trade threshold. It is a floor for study, not evidence of edge.

bands.label: Strong
bands.meaning: Broad agreement across most families and most signals.

bands.label: Full book
bands.meaning: Near-unanimous agreement with the event calendar staged. The calendar is not staged, so this band is defined but unreachable in version 1.

caps.when: fewer than six families are usable
caps.why: A missing family cannot be read as neutral; it caps conviction at the provisional trade band.

caps.when: the event calendar is not staged (F7 and both calendar factors)
caps.why: The direction may still be read from F8, but a full-book band 5 needs the known-release window.

requires: the RG-4 volatility gate is defined and open
the event family is usable (F8 has a release before the cutoff)
all twelve voting signals are usable
trade_rule.note: Provisional and research-only. No sizing, entry, stop or live execution is defined here, and no accuracy result is claimed.

event_context.consequence: The worked morning reads F8 from the archive to show the rule. The published run-v1.json does not yet consume it, so the rule is specified here but not executed by the nine-input artefact.

worked_morning.reason: First replayed morning on which every wired rule resolves, the RG-4 gate is open, and F8 has a release before the cutoff.

limitations: Research only. No figure on this page is an edge claim, and no call is published as live.
The rules are frozen by judgement before this version's accuracy was evaluated; they are not fitted to the 725 mornings.
A missing factor is abstained on, never filled with zero or a neighbouring print.
The event calendar is not staged, so band 5 cannot be reached and every band-4 result carries that cap.
F8 is specified and computed from its archive for the worked morning, but run-v1.json does not yet read it; the published challenger remains the nine-input experiment.
The band-3 trade threshold is inherited from the nine-input book. It is a research floor, not a validated gate.
